verdict.rationale: Cekura's API reference documents creating API keys through the API. It notes that keys created with API-key auth are limited to project-level keys, which implies some scoping by project. Nothing in the evidence shows finer least-privilege controls for an agent's credentials. Missing for 10: granular permission scopes (e.g. read-only or per-resource), expiry/rotation/revocation controls, agent-specific credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
